name: comp-44
title: OTP Input Grouped
description: A row of four connected single-digit slots with a shared border. The slot waiting for input carries a pale ring, and typing advances the focus until all four digits are filled.
use: Collecting a short one-time code where splitting it into digits makes entry easier to follow.
avoid: The component ships a visible third-party credit link that would need removing before production.
a11y: The label is bound and the code field takes keyboard input, but the visible slots are plain divs with no per-slot description. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A small label sits above four connected square slots sharing their borders, with rounded ends on the group. Each filled slot holds one white number, the waiting slot carries a pale ring, and a grey credit line runs below.
behaves: Typing moves the pale ring from slot to slot and drops one digit into each box, and backspace steps it the other way. The clip enters 4, 8, 2 and 9 until the group is full and the ring rests on the final slot.
customise: The four-digit length, label and credit line are fixed in the file; slot size, ring colour and border styling are classes there.
weight: light: One hidden input backed by four small slots; nothing animates or loops.
